domain_setting: A calm anatomy-learning studio with warm paper backgrounds, close-up body-part callouts, expressive character busts, and simple whole-body poses.
recurring_scale_anchors: 304x192 cards with focal shapes inside x=24..280 and y=16..176
Body-part callouts use a muted whole-body or face shape, a pale gold halo, and one saturated target region
Use varied skin tones and adult or child characters without making demographic traits the teaching target
Keep injury depictions mild and non-graphic: small bandages, surface redness, or soft swelling only
Expression and breathing scenes use clear eyes, brows, mouth shapes, and large readable gesture cues

polysemy_resolution_table.chest: The front torso or thorax, despite the Japanese gloss for a storage chest.
polysemy_resolution_table.bow (gesture): A person bending forward in greeting, despite the gloss for an archery bow.
polysemy_resolution_table.clap: Two palms striking together with motion arcs, despite the Japanese gloss emphasizing the sound.
polysemy_resolution_table.sweat / perspire: The body function of perspiring, despite the Japanese gloss listing the noun sweat.
polysemy_resolution_table.burn: A mild skin burn symptom in the injuries group, shown with a cool compress and intact skin; no flames or graphic injury.
polysemy_resolution_table.cut: A small superficial skin cut with a clean bandage nearby, no visible blood or sharp injury.
polysemy_resolution_table.sore: Tenderness shown by a gentle hand protecting a small achy spot, not a throat illness specifically.
polysemy_resolution_table.head: Whole head including face and neck, distinguished from the face-only front view.
polysemy_resolution_table.body, parts of: The body's major external regions together in an anatomy overview, not an isolated torso.
polysemy_resolution_table.tooth / teeth: Visible natural teeth within a gently smiling open mouth, with one tooth clearly highlighted.

contrast_notes.head / face / forehead / eyes / eyebrow: Use a whole head silhouette for head, full facial features for face, and tight callout crops for each single part. Keep eye parts separately visible: eye globe, eyebrow arc, eyelash fringe, nostril openings, lip outline, and tooth row.
contrast_notes.chest / stomach / waist / hip: Map each region to its correct torso height: chest high on ribcage, stomach central abdomen, waist narrow above hips, hip at pelvis side.
contrast_notes.arm / elbow / wrist / hand / finger / th: Arm is the full upper-limb silhouette; elbow is the bent joint, wrist the narrow hand connection, hand the palm, finger one long digit, thumb the shorter side digit.
contrast_notes.leg / thigh / knee / shin / ankle / foot: Use full limb for leg; thigh upper leg; knee front joint; shin lower-front leg; ankle connector; foot below ankle; toe one of the forefoot digits.
contrast_notes.blink / blush / bow / clap / cry / frown: Use distinct peak expressions and gestures, including closed eyelids for blink, head angle change for nod vs. shake, raised shoulders for shrug, teeth showing for grin, and an open laugh mouth.
contrast_notes.breathe / hold your breath / cough / shi: Breathe shows calm regular airflow; hold breath shows puffed cheeks and closed mouth; cough covers a cough; sigh releases a long breath; sneeze has a tissue and burst; snore occurs during sleep; sweat has visible droplets; shiver has compact trembling posture.
contrast_notes.bruise / burn / cut / scrape / sore / sw: Use gentle localized skin symptom cues: muted purple bruise, coral burn with cool compress, clean small bandage for cut, mild scraped patch with bandage, guarded sore region, and soft raised swelling. No gore or alarming injury details.
